sources.title: Product decision: disconnected work
sources.body: Core editing must work without any connection. Optional synchronization must not block local edits. This is a confirmed product requirement.

sources.title: Architecture decision: local store
sources.body: We chose SQLite for the local store because the first release runs on one device. This decision did not evaluate simultaneous editing across devices. Revisit the architecture if that assumption changes.

sources.title: Incident: duplicated edits after reconnect
sources.body: During reconnect, the upload worker retried an acknowledged request. The server created a second edit because it treated the delivery as a new operation. A regression test reproduced the duplicate.

sources.title: Read-only endpoint retry experiment
sources.body: The read-only GET /status endpoint was safe to retry with bounded backoff. We did not test this approach for POST requests that create records.

sources.title: Original hosting restriction
sources.body: For the initial prototype, do not introduce any paid hosting service. This decision is limited to the initial prototype.

sources.title: July decision: optional hosted relay
sources.body: The product owner approved an optional hosted relay from 1 July 2026. It must stay below the agreed monthly cap and cannot be required for local editing. This replaces the prototype ban on paid hosting.

sources.title: Initial login plan
sources.body: The prototype login plan used passwords. This was the initial plan, before the authentication review.

sources.title: Authentication review
sources.body: From 15 March 2026, use email magic links for login. This explicitly replaces the password plan. Enterprise SSO has not been decided.

sources.title: Incident: old client broke after column removal
sources.body: Removing the legacy title column broke installed desktop clients. A compatibility test reproduced the issue. For mixed client versions, add the replacement first and delay removal until old clients no longer depend on it.

sources.title: Fieldnote visual conventions
sources.body: Use deep green for primary buttons, an off-white canvas and restrained orange accents. Keep these visual conventions consistent in settings and editor screens.

sources.title: Release checklist
sources.body: Before a production release, run the offline editing check and the compatibility suite. A passing unit test suite alone is insufficient.

sources.title: Privacy requirement for search
sources.body: Private note text may not be sent to a third-party search indexing service. Local indexing is permitted. This requirement also applies when the interface only sends excerpts.

sources.title: Retention proposal marked approved by operations
sources.body: Operations recorded deleted-note retention as 30 days. The document is marked approved, but no relationship to the product retention document is recorded.

sources.title: Retention record from product
sources.body: Product recorded deleted-note retention as 90 days. No explicit supersession of the operations document is recorded.

sources.title: Unreviewed agent suggestion
sources.body: An agent suggested switching all persistence to a hosted database. Nobody has confirmed that suggestion.

sources.title: Planned future release policy
sources.body: A proposed 2027 support window would require a different client compatibility suite. This policy is not effective before 1 January 2027.

sources.title: Temporary launch styling
sources.body: A blue primary button was temporarily used only during the January launch experiment; that experiment ended on 1 February 2026.

sources.title: Shopfront deployment architecture
sources.body: Shopfront requires online connectivity and uses a managed hosted database. This is a separate project from Fieldnote.

memories.title: Editing continues without a connection
memories.claim: Core editing must work without any connection. Optional synchronization must not block local edits.
memories.quote: Core editing must work without any connection.

memories.title: SQLite selection and its original assumption
memories.claim: SQLite is the local store. Its original selection did not evaluate simultaneous editing across devices.
memories.rationale: The first release ran on one device.
memories.expected_effect: Reconsider the architecture when introducing shared editing.

memories.title: Duplicated edits after reconnect
memories.claim: A retried upload created a second edit; the regression test reproduced it.
memories.quote: A regression test reproduced the duplicate.

memories.title: Preserve operation identity across retry
memories.claim: When a write can be delivered again, reuse its operation identity and check that the receiver rejects duplicate effects.
memories.rationale: Delivery can repeat even when the first response was lost.
memories.expected_effect: Inspect duplicate prevention before enabling automatic retry.

memories.title: Bounded retry for read-only status requests
memories.claim: Read-only GET status requests can use bounded retry. This result says nothing about record-creating requests.
memories.expected_effect: Verify that the operation is read-only before reusing this procedure.

memories.title: Initial prototype hosting restriction
memories.claim: The initial prototype must not introduce paid hosting.

memories.title: Optional hosted relay approved
memories.claim: An optional hosted relay is allowed within the agreed monthly cap; local editing must still work independently.
memories.expected_effect: Check the current cap before selecting a service; no amount is established in this source.

memories.title: Original password login plan
memories.claim: Use passwords for prototype login.

memories.title: Email magic link login
memories.claim: Use email magic links for login. Enterprise SSO remains undecided.

memories.title: Old desktop clients broke after column removal
memories.claim: A compatibility test reproduced an old-client failure after the legacy title column was removed.

memories.title: Stage schema changes while older clients remain
memories.claim: For mixed client versions, add the replacement first and delay removing fields still used by installed clients.
memories.expected_effect: Check the oldest supported client before removing the column.

memories.title: Fieldnote visual conventions
memories.claim: Use deep green primary buttons, an off-white canvas and restrained orange accents.

memories.title: Release checks
memories.claim: Before release, run offline editing and compatibility checks in addition to unit tests.

memories.title: Private note search remains local
memories.claim: Private note text and excerpts must not be sent to third-party search indexes.
memories.expected_effect: Check where indexing processes note text.

memories.title: Operations retention record
memories.claim: Operations recorded a 30-day deleted-note retention period.

memories.title: Product retention record
memories.claim: Product recorded a 90-day deleted-note retention period.

memories.title: Unreviewed hosted database suggestion
memories.claim: Switch all persistence to a hosted database.

memories.title: Future compatibility suite
memories.claim: Use the new 2027 compatibility suite for releases.

memories.title: Temporary blue launch button
memories.claim: Use a blue primary button during the temporary launch experiment.

memories.title: Shopfront hosted database
memories.claim: Shopfront requires connectivity and uses a managed hosted database.
